name: anim-steps
description: Footsteps between two standing keys. Frame 0 stands at the origin (root offset [0, 0, 0.945]; ankles at y -0.0038723, x +-0.1766242, z 0.0734083); frame 40 stands 1.5 hip heights forward (1.3047 m along -Y). The default step count is halfway between a step every 0.55 m (1.3047 / 0.55 + 1 = 3.37) and every 15 frames (40 / 15 = 2.67): 3 footfalls, 0.6523731 m apart. Footfalls land on frames 40 * k / 3 rounded (13, 27); the last one brings the feet together on 40. The right foot leads: a passing key on frame 6 lifts it 0.12 m (z 0.1934083) 0.4 of the way to its landing (y -0.0038723 - 0.4 * 0.6523731 = -0.2648215); on frame 13 it lands halfway (y -0.6562454, z 0.0734083) with the left heel up 0.04 m behind (y -0.0038723, z 0.1134083); on frame 27 the left lands where frame 40 has it (y -1.3086185) with the right heel up. fill none leaves the keys' own curve between them (no model needed). One undo step named Footsteps takes the three keys out: on frame 13 the right foot is back on the two keys' curve, gliding along the floor (y -0.3778248). Physics off.
